description: Starts a life insurance application with Susman Insurance Agency for one of the priced options. It is meant for a real person who has agreed to the wording that comes before an application. The person's name, email and phone go to the agency's life insurance quoting service and to the insurance company chosen, the application is saved there, the agency is told, and the person is emailed a confirmation. The result is a link where the person continues the application themselves and answers the insurance company's own questions; nothing is bought in the chat. A driver's license number or Social Security number is not part of it, and a request that carries one is refused.

agreement.description: The agreement of the person to the wording that comes before an application.

agreed.description: True when the person has read that wording and agreed to it.

wordingVersion.description: The version of the wording the person agreed to.

applicant.description: The person the application is for.

phone.description: US phone number of the person, 10 digits.

option.description: The number of the option the person chose, as it was numbered with the prices.

quoteRef.description: The reference that came back with the prices.

name: start_life_application
title: Start a life insurance application
